desc: Derive and validate a correct polynomial-time min-cut/graph-cut construction for the minimum number of selected edges that enforces target distance D.
Prove the distance-label equivalence and correspondence between cuts/labels and a set of selected original edges, including parallel edges.
Determine valid binary-search bounds and feasibility monotonicity; justify extension from at most K to exactly K selected edges.
Implement the resulting algorithm with a max-flow/min-cut routine within the required bounds.
Verify the implementation on the samples and relevant edge cases (notably direct/parallel edges and zero-weight paths).
